memo:
Found
The audit confirmed 50 behavior bugs, ranked by severity as high, medium, and low. High-severity bugs return wrong results for allowed inputs. Most important are strassen_matrix_multiplication.py:174 strassen, closest_pair_of_points.py:103 closest_pair_of_points_sqr, polybius.py:85 PolybiusCipher.decode, move_to_front.py:75 move_to_front_decode, rank_of_matrix.py:60 rank_of_matrix, and check_anagrams.py:35 check_anagrams. Medium bugs include enigma_machine2.py:141 _plugboard, set_matrix_zeroes.py:51 set_matrix_zeroes, minimum_size_subarray_sum.py:36 minimum_subarray_sum, lru_cache.py:310 and lfu_cache.py:262 cache_decorator_wrapper treating None as a miss, and token_bucket.py:76 allow_request. Low: activity_selection.py:40 activity_selection crashes on empty input.

How it was checked
Every file was read. 236 workers made 247 calls. Each finding was confirmed by independent skeptics using sandbox evidence.

Not covered
The audit did not cover test coverage, regression results, performance, security, concurrency, thread safety, or documentation completeness.

Next
Fix the high-severity wrong-result bugs first, starting with strassen, closest pair, Polybius decode, move-to-front decode, matrix rank, and anagram check. Add regression tests for the confirmed calls and edge cases, including empty input, None cache values, and exact token counts. Re-run sandbox confirmation after fixes.
